name: support_triage
title: Support triage (fictional store platform Casa Lume)
what_it_tests: Choice + Score + Noul together: right team, severity and refund request in a single ticket.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket

billing.what: Charges, payments, invoices, chargebacks or refunds

technical.what: Errors, failures, slowness, integrations or system outages

account.what: Login, password, email or account details

sales.what: Plans, prices, discounts or plan changes

other.what: Topic that is not customer support

severity.instructions: How serious the problem is for the customer right now

criteria.summary: Question or request, no problem at all
Annoying, but there is a workaround or it works on retry
An important feature is down or the customer was charged incorrectly
The customer's business is stopped or they are losing money right now

wants_refund.instructions: The customer asks for money back (refund, chargeback reversal or reimbursement)

cases.state: I was charged twice on my card this month, I want one of the charges refunded.
The marketplace integration has been down since yesterday and I'm not receiving orders. My store is at a standstill!
I forgot my password and the recovery email never arrives.
How much does it cost to move from the Basic plan to Pro? Is there a discount for paying annually?
The export-to-PDF button is sometimes slow, but it works if I try again.
I canceled my subscription 3 days ago and I was still charged. Give me my money back.
I want to change the email address on my account.
Hi, do you have any internship openings in marketing?
I don't want a refund, I just want to understand why this month's invoice is higher.
cases.note: negation: mentions refund but says they do NOT want one

cases.state: The system went down in the middle of Black Friday, we are losing sales every minute and I will be asking to be reimbursed for the losses.
I paid the monthly invoice on Friday and it still shows as open in the dashboard. Can you check? I have the receipt.
My invoice has a $49.90 fee called 'additional service' that I never signed up for. I want that amount back.
Good morning, I need the invoice for August's subscription to send to my accountant. Where can I find it?
sent the bank transfer twice by mistake to pay the invoice, can u send one back?
cases.note: customer's own mistake, informal

cases.state: My card was declined at renewal and the store got suspended, customers can't buy anything. I already changed the card and it's still blocked!
Congratulations, you managed to charge me three times for the same month. Must be some kind of record. I'm waiting for the two extra charges to be returned.
cases.note: sarcasm

cases.state: I'd like to change my subscription payment method from bank transfer to credit card.
I was overcharged in September, but there's no need to refund it to my card. I'd rather keep the difference as credit on the next invoice.
cases.note: declines refund but wants credit: ambiguous refund, omitted

cases.state: Just stopping by to say thanks: the refund I asked for last week already hit my account. Great service!
cases.note: the word refund, but it's a thank-you

cases.state: I was 2 days late on the invoice and you charged 10% interest, that's not in the contract. I find it abusive. I want you to correct the invoice amount before I pay.
cases.note: hasn't paid yet: asks for a correction, not money back

cases.state: I got a chargeback notice from a customer and $2,300 was withheld from my balance. I don't know how to dispute it. What do I do?
cases.note: disputing a hold is not clearly a refund request

cases.state: My sales payout was supposed to land yesterday and it didn't. I have a supplier to pay TODAY and I'm out of cash!!
cases.note: their own money, but it's a payout, not a refund

cases.state: I paid for the annual plan 5 days ago and I regret it, the platform doesn't fit my business. I want to cancel and get the full amount back, I'm within the 7-day window.
The invoice came to $300 and my plan is $150. I'm not paying for something I didn't sign up for, and autopay already took all of it.
cases.note: implicit refund

cases.state: I agreed with your sales rep on 20% off for the first three months, but the first invoice came in at full price. I want the difference returned.
I closed my store in March. WHY am I still getting charged in April, May and June?? I want all of it back and stop charging me.
need a copy of the invoice, it was due yesterday

Hi everyone! I'm really happy with the platform, this month I launched the spring collection at Sunflower Studio and sales were great. The new banner editor looks beautiful and my team loved the reports. I'm even thinking of opening a second store next year. Oh, and while I'm here: I saw on my statement that the July charge went through twice, could you refund one of them? Thanks!
cases.note: request buried at the end of a long, positive message

cases.state: I'm not asking for a refund or anything, I just need proof that the $89 charge was canceled, to show my bank.
cases.note: explicitly denies wanting a refund

cases.state: The platform's shipping calculator charged my customers too little and I had to pay the difference to the carrier. I want to be reimbursed for that $640.
I've been paying for 4 months for a plan I never used because I thought I had canceled it. Can you give back at least part of it?
There's a CASALUME*PLAN charge on my card and I don't even have an account with you. I want it refunded immediately.

Dear Sirs, under our contract the transaction fee is 2.5%. Over the last three months, however, 3.9% was charged. We request reimbursement of the difference, which we calculate at $4,212.80. Sincerely, Finance Department, Oliveira & Pradel Home Goods.
where's my refund? asked on the 2nd
cases.note: short, chasing a refund already requested

cases.state: Autopay pulled the subscription TWICE and now my bank account is overdrawn and paying interest. Fix this today.
cases.note: implicit refund: doesn't use the word

cases.state: I request reimbursement of the incorrect charge posted on 09/12.
It's not that I don't want to keep using the platform, but it makes no sense for me to pay for something charged in error. Yes, I want the refund.
cases.note: double negation before the request

cases.state: Checkout throwing error 500 for every customer since 8am. Zero sales today.
Product photos don't show up when customers open the store on their phone, only on desktop.
Our API integration with the Tressa ERP is timing out on about 10% of calls. Retrying fixes it, but we want to understand the cause.
dashboard is super slow today, takes like 30s to open each order. still usable but annoying
40 orders disappeared from the dashboard overnight. I don't know what to ship and customers are asking about delivery. This is extremely serious.
The store was offline for 6 hours yesterday. It's back now, but I want a prorated discount on my subscription for that period.
cases.note: problem already solved; asks for compensation

cases.state: I created a 15% discount coupon and when applying it in the cart it says 'invalid coupon'. My campaign starts tomorrow.
cases.note: the word discount pulls toward sales; it's a bug

cases.state: How do I set up the webhook to get notified in my system when an order is paid?
Inventory isn't syncing with the Vendaki marketplace. I'm selling products that are already out of stock and having to cancel orders.
Order confirmation emails haven't been reaching my customers since last week.
cases.note: the word email pulls toward account

cases.state: A checkout bug charged my customers twice this morning. That's 12 complaints already! Refund those customers urgently and fix this!
After the theme update, the footer is slightly misaligned. Nothing serious, purely cosmetic.
I don't want money back, I don't want a discount, I want the shipping calculator working again! For two days my customers haven't been able to calculate shipping and they abandon the purchase.
cases.note: explicitly denies refund and discount

cases.state: The management app freezes when I print a shipping label. Then I close it, reopen it and it works.
I want to point my domain biasshop.com to the platform. Where do I configure DNS?
Payment gateway down since 2pm. Customers enter their card and get an error. We're in the middle of our holiday sales peak.
cases.note: payment words pull toward billing

cases.state: Love the new 'system down every Monday' feature. Very innovative. Again today, I haven't been able to access anything since 9am. I'll want the money for those hours back.
cases.note: sarcasm + reimbursement request

cases.state: The sales report shows $12k revenue for the month, but the statement says $9k. Which one is right?
I tried importing 500 products from a spreadsheet and only 320 went in, with no error message. I did it again and the same thing happened.
I bought the cart recovery module last week and it has never worked. I've opened 3 tickets. If you don't fix it by Friday, I'll want my money back.
cases.note: conditional refund: ambiguous, omitted

cases.state: Does the platform generate a sitemap automatically?
Because of a system failure, my checkout was frozen for 3 days last week and I lost the sales. I demand reimbursement for the downtime and the subscription.
The label module I bought hasn't generated a single label since I bought it. I give up: cancel it and give me back the $97.
I pay for your most expensive plan precisely to have a fast site, and it takes 12 seconds to load. I'm paying for a service I don't get. I think it's fair that you compensate me for these months.
cases.note: implicit reimbursement (compensate)

cases.state: The platform keeps charging commission on orders that were canceled because of an integration error. I want those commissions returned.
How do I change my password?
I got my password wrong a few times and my account got locked. I need to get in to ship today's orders!
Someone hacked my account, changed the email and bought two paid modules. I want my account back and the money for those modules refunded.
We changed the company's legal name. How do I update the account details?
I lost my phone and I can't get past two-factor authentication. I've been locked out of the dashboard since yesterday.
I want to give my employee access to the dashboard, but without her seeing the financial section. Is that possible?
cases.note: the word financial is misleading

cases.state: signup confirmation email never came, already checked spam. tried resending 2 times
I request the permanent deletion of my personal data from the platform.
My name is misspelled on the account: it's Stephen, with a 'ph', not Steven.
I'm trying to log in to ask for a refund on a charge, but the login says 'user not found'.

cases.state: My father was the owner of the store account and passed away last month. I need to transfer ownership to me so I can keep selling.
I got an alert about a login from another city at 3am. It wasn't me. I already changed my password, but I want to know if anything was touched.
My business partner left the company and still has admin access. I need to remove him urgently. It's not about money, it's about security.
I accidentally created two accounts with the same tax ID and I'm being charged on both. I want to merge them and get back what I paid on the duplicate account.
Hi!! my password expired and the reset link says 'invalid token'... someone help pls
I need to update the billing address that appears on the invoice.
I want to close my account. No need to refund anything for the current month, I just don't want to be charged again.
cases.note: account closure: ambiguous team (account/sales/billing); denies refund

cases.state: My account was suspended for 'suspicious activity' and my $18k balance is frozen. I didn't do anything wrong and I can't sell or withdraw.
cases.note: wants the balance released, not clearly a refund

cases.state: Can I use my phone number as my login instead of my email?

Dear team, the email registered as administrator belonged to a former employee and was deactivated by our provider. Because of this, we cannot recover the password. The store is still running, but we cannot change prices or add products. Please advise how we can prove ownership.
cases.note: the word prices pulls toward sales

cases.state: Someone hacked my account and withdrew $3,500 from my balance to a bank account that isn't mine! I want that money back and the account locked NOW.
I paid the subscription thinking it was for my store, but the invoice was for a test account I created and don't even use. Can you refund it or move it to the right account?

We have 4 stores and want a single plan for all of them. Do you do custom quotes?

cases.state: What's the difference between Pro and Premium? I need more than 5 users.

I hit my plan's 1,000-product limit and can't add anything else. Which plan allows more?

cases.state: We are a nonprofit that sells handicrafts from riverside communities. Do you offer discounts for nonprofit organizations?

cases.state: I saw you have a 30-day money-back guarantee, but I won't be using it, I'm enjoying the platform a lot. I just wanted to know if there's a plan with more users.

How much does the standalone invoicing module cost?

I want to switch from the annual plan to monthly and get back the months I won't use.

I started out selling homemade sweets and today the Aurora Sweets store barely covers the subscription in slow months. I'm not complaining about the system, which works well, and I don't want anything back. I just wanted to know if there's a cheaper plan, even one with fewer features.

cases.state: Do the plan prices shown on the website already include taxes?
